task: changepoint-detector flagship item (w): the watch's label-free floors on a fresh labelled multi-sensor set
errors: Committed a stub run record and an empty output file mid-run so that the stop hook stops reporting untracked files; both were replaced before merge.

doc_friction.issue: The untracked-files stop hook fires at every pause during a long background eval, while its output file is still being written; the only way to quiet it is to commit an incomplete file. A note on long evals (write output to the scratchpad, copy in at the end) would avoid it.

deviations.why: Hourly buckets, not finer: SMD's segments are mostly under an hour, but a timing-only pilot put 30-minute buckets at about 8x the cost (over 10 h).
deviations.did: Pre-registered hourly buckets and reported caught segments by length (under 60 minutes / longer) so the dilution shows.
deviations.result: 222 of 309 segments are under an hour; the floors caught 15-52 of them, and 27-54 of the 87 longer ones.

notes: Round 18 pre-registered in commit 25cf5e449 before any scored run. Fresh set: SMD (OmniAnomaly, MIT), 28 servers, 862 varying metrics, hourly buckets, 5,361 s on 4 cores.
